item.text: {"verdict_id":"L3-a4f91c2e","level":"L3","outcome":"fail","defect_class_hypothesis":"ui_rendering","trigger_steps":["应用已在主界面启动，未使用 launcher search 或 intent","从底部导航点击 Search tab（nav_tab_search）","停止在 Search tab，未点击 search_card 或进入 SearchActivity","最终布局确认 nav_tab_search 为 selected，search_card 可见"],"evidence":[{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"Final checkpoint layout JSON: nav_tab_search","note":"底部 Search tab 可见且处于 selected 状态，因此满足规格中可判定的前提条件，不应返回 inconclusive。"},{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"Final checkpoint layout JSON: search_card/search_text_view/search_icon","note":"search_card 可见，center 为 [540,302]；其子节点 search_text_view 文本为 \"Track what you've been reading here.\"，search_icon 的 content-desc 也为 \"Track what you've been reading here.\"。该文案描述阅读历史，而不是邀请用户搜索 Wikipedia 或搜索/提问。"},{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"功能规格","note":"规格明确要求 Search tab 上的 search_card 必须描述 Search 功能，且不得描述 reading history、recently viewed articles、saved pages、edit activity 或其他非搜索功能。当前文案违反该要求。"}],"confidence":0.97}
